text:
Alex Kim: hey team — hit a weird statefile collision while importing the eu GPU nodegroup into the 'eu-prod-gpu' workspace. I set backend config with eu bucket but CI used the us backend and applied. now there are two live ASG/nodegroups and the autoscaler sees double capacity.

Maria Chen: :eyes: can you paste the init/apply error or state output?

Alex Kim: here's the last bits from CI logs:
```
terraform init -backend-config=bucket=redwood-tf-eu -backend-config=prefix=eu/prod
apply: success (exit 0)
state pull shows both resources:
module.gpu.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu["eu-prod"] and module.gpu.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu["eu-prod#1"]
```

Samir Patel: OK that's a backend config mismatch + retry race. CI probably retried against a different workspace (us) creating duplicate resources. First step: pause gitops and CI for eu-prod workspace, and mark nodes draining. Ops-runbook link: <https://runbook.internal/terraform-state-reconcile>

Maria Chen: Agreed. Proposed command sequence to rehydrate correct state and remove duplicate:
```
# switch to the correct backend
terraform init -backend-config=bucket=redwood-tf-eu -backend-config=prefix=eu/prod
# identify the dup resource
terraform state list | grep aws_autoscaling_group
# remove the accidental copy from wrong backend workspace
terraform state rm module.gpu.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu["eu-prod#1"]
# import if needed to canonical resource id
terraform import module.gpu.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu["eu-prod"] asg-0123456789
```

Alex Kim: autoscaler alert fired: infra-bot: GPU pool count jump from 48 -> 96. We already scaled down new nodes but drains still running. :grimacing:

infra-bot: ALERT: autoscaler-gpu-eu spike (48 -> 96) at 2026-03-20T10:12:03Z. Created incident INC-4632.

Samir Patel: I'll coordinate with oncall to cordon/drain the duplicated nodes, then run the state rm against the workspace that owns the accidental copy. Need someone to hold the gitops merge queue.

Maria Chen: I'll hold merges and patch the CI pipeline to explicitly set TF_WORKSPACE and backend bucket. Also will add a quick check to gate retries.

Alex Kim: thanks — I'll do the manual state rm/import and post command output here. Will also add a short note to the runbook.

Samir Patel: Thanks. action items: @alex run state rm/import, @maria patch CI and hold merges, @samir coordinate drain w/ oncall. :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: on it.
